steps.expect: Do you trust the files in this folder?

steps.send: Use the commentable-html skill to write C:\demo\report.html - a short review report for a plan to add rate limiting to our public API. It MUST contain all of: prose paragraphs, an inline SVG image, a Mermaid diagram, a fenced code diff, and a Chart.js chart, so every kind of content is commentable. Keep the content short - one screen per section. When the file is written, print exactly REPORT-READY on its own line and end your turn.
